label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: The chaise, raised left head, pillow, paneled wall and brown floor establish the corresponding scene. Architectural edges and furniture ornament are substantially simplified.

The chaise remains in front of the paneled wall, with its head and pillow left and extended seat right. A foreground furniture fragment remains at lower left; the left window treatment is only crudely represented.
Seat length, width, raised head and supporting legs retain plausible relative proportions, although the head upholstery is bulkier and the pillow smaller than the target.

Pale upholstery, subdued olive frame, cream wall and dark brown floor preserve the main color organization. Curved legs and faint seat stripes remain recognizable despite lost carving and fabric detail.

The authored view clearly exposes the furniture and wall with soft illumination and coherent under-seat shadows. The black and obstructed evaluator views do not establish a lighting failure in the authored view.
The authored view and close evaluator view show volumetric cushions, projecting frame members and wall moldings from different viewpoints.

Actual mesh records locate the seat core, head, pillow and architecture in editable hierarchies. Box.014, Ball.010, Box.016 and Box.001 have finite nonempty meshes and assigned materials with shader links.

dimension_scores.evidence: The subject and room identity are clear, but the inflated head forms, thin tubular frame and simplified surroundings lose much of the reference's character.
Legs visibly support the seat, but the head upholstery bulges beyond its frame and frame-to-cushion connections appear awkward.
The broad palette corresponds, while ornate carved framing becomes plain rods and the shaped upholstered sides become rounded lobes.
Visible faceting, primitive cushion shapes, render grain and sparse surface detail reduce credibility.
Principal left-right and foreground-background relationships survive. Window treatment and peripheral architectural composition are less faithful.
Overall chaise proportions are plausible, but the head is overly bulky, the pillow undersized and the frame unusually slender.
Soft light and grounding shadows make the scene legible. Fabric, wood and painted surfaces lack distinctive texture, and the lighting is flatter than the target.
Main furniture, pillow, label, wall paneling and floor are present. Curtains and foreground chair are rudimentary, with substantial decorative detail omitted.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
